title: Astrea guide
loading: Loading the local observation and its projection…
empty: No local FITS match these coordinates, size or detector. Use the Barnard field, 7 arcminutes and D3.

welcome.title: Explore Astrea
welcome.summary: Learn the interface with real images of Barnard's Star.

1.title: Follow the tour
1.description: Click Next to discover the controls.

2.title: Try it without losing your work
2.description: Your previous session returns when you leave.

welcome.note: You can skip the guide and reopen it from the question mark.

time.title: Sky time
time.summary: This clock orients the sky; it does not change image acquisition dates.

1.title: Try the clock
1.description: Switch between Return to current time and Pause time.

2.title: Choose another date
2.description: Enter a UTC date and click Apply date.

time.note: The tutorial starts with the clock paused; you can change it.

location.title: Observer location
location.summary: Location allows observations to be placed in the local sky.

1.title: Check the reference
1.description: The tutorial uses Greenwich, not your actual location.

2.title: Try another location
2.description: Enter latitude and longitude or use device location.

location.note: These changes only affect the tutorial.

search.title: Search the Barnard field
search.summary: Load the observation from the Preparation form.

1.title: Keep the prepared values
1.description: Leave the supplied coordinates and the 7-arcminute size.

2.title: Find the observation
2.description: Click Search coordinates to open the FITS in the inspector.

search.note: If you advance without searching, the guide loads the file automatically.

sky.title: Sky appearance
sky.summary: Control the stars and the reference surface.
sky.note: The next step opens Data in the right inspector.

data.title: Data
data.summary: The highlighted tab shows the observation's properties.

1.title: Inspect the image
1.description: Review the date, detector D3 and dimensions.

2.title: Restore the framing
2.description: Click Center image to see the complete cutout.

data.note: Open original FITS remains available at the bottom of the panel.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.summary: The highlighted tab adjusts how the image is displayed.

1.title: Try the appearance
1.description: Change the palette, brightness or opacity.

2.title: Return to the initial look
2.description: Click Reset appearance to reset the visual settings.

appearance.note: Scientific filters use planes from the real FITS.

compare.title: Compare
compare.summary: The highlighted tab lets you alternate between two real observations.

1.title: Choose the dates
1.description: Keep 2025 and the same D3 detector.

2.title: Add another observation
2.description: Click Add on the available date.

3.title: Play the sequence
3.description: Click Play and adjust the time per image.

compare.note: The dates are 6.6 hours apart; visible motion is not guaranteed.
